name: Enthalpy v0.4.14
notes:
# Enthalpy v0.4.14

## Improved

- Agent Chat now shows responses as they arrive and gives clearer status for
  active, completed, cancelled, and failed work.
- Agent file proposals now have a review step. You can inspect the proposed
  files and apply or reject the complete change.

## Fixed

- Completing tasks from the Tasks view now saves an open source note first.
  This prevents false change conflicts and keeps the source checkbox and task
  record consistent.

## Preview limits

- Hosted Sync remains available only to the approved owner account on macOS
  Apple Silicon. Windows Sync enrollment is deferred until its installed-build
  acceptance passes.
- Use only disposable test data until the independent protocol and cryptographic
  review is complete.
- Account creation stays invite-only with a hard one-account limit.
- Linux packages are deferred.
